explication: Nakama is a team-oriented AI agent platform: users choose an agent in the dashboard or a connected chat channel, send a message, and receive an agent response. The product spans tenant and profile configuration, conversation handling, model providers, tools and skills, memory, and channel delivery. The README documents these capabilities; the sampled HTTP and channel code confirms some routing and message-handling details. Several runtime links remain dashed because their implementations were not sampled.
